values.note: Free, first come; no reservations at Kansas state fishing lakes. Seven consecutive days at a state fishing lake, then five days away (K.A.R. 115-8-9(c), amended 2023); a longer stay needs a written KDWP permit.

note: KDWP state fishing lake (281 acres) with 220 acres of wooded upland, southwest of Louisburg beside US-69. Gravel pullouts for camping with picnic tables and fire rings, posted on the north side of the lake only; camping is no longer allowed on the south side. One vault toilet by the double boat ramp. Carry out your trash; no swimming and no alcohol; drive on maintained roads and parking only. --Claude
